tse_present: Following the Timestream Entanglement, the heroes of the Present timeline assembled to face the crisis but not all survived. Amongst the casualties was Captain America.
avengers_1: At some point, a new team of Avengers is assembled.
cap_1:
Captain America stays frozen for a century before being found and captured by Alchemax in the year 2099. He's then rescued by Black Widow.

Together they escaped the lab but soon after part ways.

With the help of Wolverine, Steve finds the embassy of Wakanda, whose king he befriended during World War II. The embassy however had been abandoned for years.

Wolverine then activated a Kimoyo bead and a strange portal opened. This lead Steve to the Intergalactic Empire of Wakanda where he was welcomed by T'Challa and Shuri, the latter offering him a new shield.

Black Panther tasks Captain America to find heroes from across the timelines and bring them to their side.
hydra_0:
The Timestream Entanglement disrupted the timelines at Earth's two poles resulting in the appearance of Chronovium in the South Pole.

Hydra sets up a base on the Charteris Mount, on top of a much older set of ruins.

At the lowest section of the base they began mining Chronovium using it to siphon life force from Hive creatures, which is then used to create their Super-Soldiers.

On the sublevels they're also trying to open a portal to Maveth, believing it to be the key to unlocking their history and ushering a new era where Hydra reigns supreme.
hydra_1:
The Winter Soldier is sent to infiltrate and gather intel about Hydra activity inside Charteris Mount. He tried to destroy the Hive chamber but was overwhelmed by Hydra soldiers who tore off his cybernetic arm.

He was taken to the base's Super-Soldier Lab where Hydra turned his arm into squid-like appendages and he was locked up in a glass tank. He would later be taken by the Occult Ops as Hydra planned to use him a conduit to access Maveth. At some point the Hydra Priests sang an hymn around him before returning him to the lab.
hydra_2:
Three days after the Winter Soldier infiltrated the base, in the same week Captain America died, Agent 13 flies Hawkeye to Rock Island, giving him the mission of rescuing Bucky.

He navigates his way inside and reaches the Super-Soldier Lab, there he finds Bucky inside a tank labeled 'CANARY'. He fights a Hydra Super-Soldier, who unintentionally frees Bucky, the latter uses his tentacles to defeat the Super-Soldier.
hydra_3:
Hawkeye and the Winter Soldier move to the lower levels, to the Hive chamber, onto an altar near a portal radiating ancient energy with a creature trying to come through. Bucky extended his tentacles into carvings on the altar. The creature emerging from the portal wrapped its tentacles around him and it was as if a circuit had been completed and the Winter Soldier was the conduit.

Hawkeye cut Bucky's tentacles, releasing a shockwave of energy. The chamber’s walls and pillars begging to topple. Then the portal surged with energy and the creature retreated back to the other side.
hydra_4:
Wakanda manages to hijack and redirect Hydra's portal energy signature to open a gateway of their own, leading Captain America to the depths of the Charteris Base.

As the area begun collapsing, he shows up through the portal to save the duo, taking them to Wakanda where they're greeted by  Black Panther and Shuri. The latter offers Bucky a new arm.
hydra_5:
The Hive's influence starts taking over the Winter Soldier. Both his eyes and the ones of a statue of Bast nearby begin glowing deep red.

Tentacles start rapidly growing where Bucky's new arm was, intertwined with the technology of the limb.

Clint leaves in a Wakandan ship to warn T'Challa and Shuri, while Steve stays fighting Bucky.

Clint returns with Shuri who comes up with a plan to help Bucky. Clint then shoots an arrow at him with a Kimoyo bead which rebooted his arm allowing him to return to normal.
